commitMessage:

dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.javadoc.useAstNodesEscapedString>
<!description: Replace JavadocHover.getEscapedStringLiteral with ASTNodes.getEscapedStringLiteral to use a shared utility method.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.java.hover.JavadocHover.getEscapedStringLiteral($value$)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.dom.ASTNodes.getEscapedStringLiteral($value$)
;;

Fixed bug 41302: [quick assist] [extract method] Calling extract method
from a selection
dslRule:
<!id: ast-offset-comparison-fix>
<!description: Corrects offset comparison for Statement.getStartPosition() from exclusive to inclusive, fixing bug 41302 in JDT AST processing logic.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$offset < $s.getStartPosition() :: instanceof($s, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.Statement")
=> $offset <= $s.getStartPosition()
;;
summary: Transforms `offset < s.getStartPosition()` to `offset <= s.getStartPosition()` for `org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.Statement` instances, addressing an off-by-one bug in AST position comparison logic identified as bug 41302 in Eclipse JDT. The change makes the comparison inclusive.

dslRule:
/*!id: jface.text.ICharacterPairMatcher.match.signature
<!description: Update ICharacterPairMatcher.match() signature to use separate offset and length parameters, improving selection handling.
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: api-migration, jface>
*/
$matcher.match($document, $region.getOffset() + $region.getLength()) :: instanceof($region, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IRegion") && instanceof($matcher, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.ICharacterPairMatcher")
=>
$matcher.match($document, $region.getOffset(), $region.getLength())
;;
summary: Refactor ICharacterPairMatcher.match() calls to use separate offset and length parameters, aligning with a new API signature for improved handling of text selections.
